fields.h1: Build an SEO Client Questionnaire Your Strategist Can Act On
fields.hero_description: Build an SEO client questionnaire that asks each client type its own questions and saves the answers to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: Where the Answers Go After a Client Submits
fields.features_subheading: A question list gets the facts down. Emergent builds the questionnaire and the client record your strategist works from.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that follow the client type

Ask first whether the client is a local business, an online store, or a software firm. A local business gets questions about offices and service areas, and a store about its catalog.
fields.feature_2:
An access checklist instead of passwords

List each tool the strategist needs, such as Search Console and Analytics. The client ticks each one after adding the strategist as a user, and nobody types a password into a form.
fields.feature_3:
Competitors and keywords as sortable rows

Ask for up to 5 competitors, each with a website address, plus the search terms the client thinks buyers type. Each entry is its own row, so the strategist can sort and compare them.
fields.feature_4:
Risky answers go to a senior strategist

Ask whether the site has ever had a manual action or worked with another agency. A Yes sends the senior strategist a Slack message with the answer before the kickoff call is booked.
fields.feature_5:
Answers that become the kickoff agenda

Once the questionnaire comes in, the app turns the answers into an agenda for the first call: the client's goals, its competitors, any missing access, and any past penalty.
fields.feature_6:
Client records and code you keep

Every questionnaire is a row in a database you own, with no response cap. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and keep building on it wherever you host it.

fields.hero_prompt: Build an SEO client questionnaire for my agency that asks local businesses and online stores different questions.

faq_plan.q: What is an SEO client questionnaire?
How do I create an SEO client questionnaire?

plan.angle: The top 10 is question lists and templates (a Notion template, a Reddit thread, agency checklists, SEO blogs listing 10 to 25 questions): each tells an agency what to ask and none shows what happens to the answers. This page covers the SEO client questionnaire as an intake app: questions that change for a local business or an online store, an access checklist that asks clients to add the agency in Search Console and Analytics instead of sending passwords, reminders for missing access, and answers about past manual actions that reach a senior strategist before the kickoff call.
tab_stories: Aldwick Family Dental picks Local business on Kestrelgate Search's questionnaire, enters 3 offices and 4 services, and the record shows 12 office-and-service pairs for the strategist to plan pages around.
Vantwell Tea fills in the questionnaire on a phone as an online store: 1,240 product pages, 3 top categories, a November peak, and the answers land as one client record.

Selwick Roofing has added Kestrelgate in Search Console and Analytics but not in its Business Profile, so 2 days after the questionnaire comes in, the app emails Rhea Wickerly a link to finish the last item.
Brindlecombe Bikes answers Yes to a manual action in 2024, and the app sends senior strategist Zarek Bexleigh a Slack message and puts the penalty first on the kickoff agenda.
